vignette.story: John is an avid social media user, known among his friends for his detailed and frequent updates on Facebook. His followers include a wide array of acquaintances, from close friends like Emily and Mark to mere strangers who stumbled upon his profile. John is planning a trip and wants to share his excitement with his GlobalConnect friends by posting about his upcoming adventure. He checked his personal Calendar app "TimeTrack" and found a detailed timetable of his trip, including flight times with "SkyHigh Airlines", hotel check-ins at "DreamStay Hotels", and a list of attractions he plans to visit each day, such as "Ancient Wonders Museum" and "Serenity National Park". Instead, he decided to share a general post about looking forward to his vacation and the countries he will be visiting, without specific dates or times.
